notes: ADR-0182 wide daily index history: underlyings plus the volatility term structure and tail indices Cboe publishes as free CSVs. SPX (1975), OEX (1983), DJX (1997), XSP/RUT/MRUT; VIX1D/VIX9D/VIX/VIX3M/VIX6M/VIX1Y (term structure), VVIX (vol of VIX), SKEW (tail), VXN/RVX/VXD (Nasdaq/Russell/Dow vol), GVZ/OVX/VXEEM/VXSLV/VXTLT (gold, oil, EM, silver, bonds) and single-stock VXAPL/VXAZN/VXGOG/VXGS/VXIBM. NDX/XND history is not served by Cboe (403). A separate source from 'cboe-index' because the pack keeps one cursor per stream (adding symbols to a backfilled source would skip them). Register as 'cboe-index-wide'; backfill once, then acquire daily.
